name: Explore
intro: Explore is SmartVideo's inspiration page. Look through trending templates, borrow a ready-made prompt, and see what kinds of templates are available when you need a fresh idea.

features.trending-templates: Trending Templates shows eight template cards, each with a thumbnail, name and short description. Click one to open it in the Template Studio and start from a popular format.
features.prompt-library: The Prompt Library has twelve curated image prompts, each labeled with a category and model. Press Try this prompt to send it to Image Studio, then tweak the subject.
features.browse-by-category: Browse by Category shows a card for each template category, with the number of templates inside. It's a quick way to see which kinds of templates exist.

outro: That's Explore. Pick a prompt or a template that sparks something, then make it your own.
